exposure: percutaneous image-guided drainage combined with antibiotics
cohort: The cohort consisted of 45 patients diagnosed with infected bladder flap hematoma after Cesarean section, identified from 255 patients who underwent postpartum pelvic imaging between January 1, 1999, and April 1, 2022.
finding: Percutaneous image-guided drainage is safe and highly effective in managing infected bladder flap hematomas that do not respond to antibiotics, with no increased risk of uterine scar dehiscence.
